prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE newly illustrated Faron nursery-helper mermaid game sprite on a genuinely transparent square RGBA canvas, complete from head to the ends of her tail fins, with ample empty padding. No scene, floor, lettering, frames, shadows outside the character or separate decorative objects.

Keep her established identity: warm golden-blonde hair, gentle green eyes, burgundy long-sleeved blouse, cream nursery apron with a pale lavender scalloped collar and hem, blue-grey waist tie and one blue-grey front pocket bearing a large simple gold crescent and star. One connected burgundy mermaid tail curls toward the right into a large burgundy two-lobed fluke. No crown or rainbow hair and no costume changes.

She is a warm attentive helper, looking toward her two EMPTY receiving hands held forward below her chest. Both arms connect naturally to her shoulders, with visible rounded elbows and two useful cupped palms. No infant, swaddle or other prop is baked into the artwork; the game owns the infant separately.

The specific refinement is SIMPLER MATTE PAINTED FORMS. Use broad rounded toy-playset masses, a confident dark-plum contour, two broad flat painted value bands per form and a small lavender shadow shape. Group the blonde hair into five or six large quiet curl shapes with one broad gold highlight per cluster; no individual strands or shiny ribbons. Draw a softly round face, small simple nose, calm green illustrated eyes and a tiny warm closed smile. Use spare facial marks and no lipstick, cosmetics, eyeliner or long lashes. Keep the cream apron quiet with one large shadow patch rather than fabric folds or texture. The burgundy tail has a single gentle plum shadow band and simple broad fins. Hands have a thumb and a small readable group of rounded fingers, with no anatomical rendering or knuckle detail. High-key face and hands, soft warm burgundy identity colour, lavender shadows. Clean substantial plum/navy contours should remain visible at about180 game pixels tall.

Polished children's painted 2D game art, neither a fashion princess portrait nor a glossy doll: no photorealism, 3D lighting, gradients modeling skin or cloth, delicate hair lines, textile fibers, scale texture, fine fingernails, glamorous adult features or white sticker rim. Preserve charm and craft through the silhouette, colour grouping and purposeful expression. Return only this one complete empty-handed character with native generated transparency. This is a fresh text-only generation, with no source images or delivery pixels bound.
